newsitem.title: UK: NatWest denies interest in Napoli.
newsitem.headline: NatWest denies interest in Napoli.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc on Tuesday said it was not considering a bid for Italy's Banco di Napoli.
"We are not considering making a bid for any part of Banco di Napoli," a NatWest spokesman told Reuters.
Newspaper reports in Italy have speculated that NatWest was among a group of banks considering seperate bids for control of the bank which has recently been making huge losses.
The Italian Treasury has put 60 percent of Banco di Napoli up for sale and interested parties have until December 20 to make offers.

Britain's largest banks have generally been cutting their exposure to retail banking in continental Europe in recent years after several loss-making forays. -- Joe Ortiz, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
